subject: Orbit results handoff & scheduling: logistics playbook and run-of-show
messages:
From: Amaya Tanaka <amaya@orbitalai.com>

Cc: Sam Rogers <procurement@orbitalai.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: performance readout + stakeholders (AE/SE/proc/security)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the run we did last week — the team is keen to get a structured readout of the latency/perf results so we can baseline against our SLOs. Can you help coordinate a 45–60 minute session that includes: AE (sales), SE (technical deep-dive), our procurement rep (Sam), and security (Lia) to confirm data handling? We want to cover the following at a minimum: overall p50/p95/p99, observed tail behavior under burst, KV cache on/off comparison, and any runbook changes required for production.

I attached the preliminary metrics snapshot (orbital_prelim_metrics.zip) — happy to share more logs if helpful. Best windows for our engineers are 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-15 between 08:00–17:00 PT.

Let me know who on your side should be present and a couple of time options.

—Amaya
Senior Platform Engineer
OrbitalAI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Amaya — thanks for the context and the metrics file. We can lead the readout and will make sure procurement and security questions are addressed. Proposed plan:

- Attendees: Avery (AE), Monica (SE, will present latency deep-dive), Vivek (sales lead / program owner), Karthik (optional for escalation)
- Duration: 60 minutes (40m demo/readout + 15m Q&A + 5m action items)
- Slots we can offer: 2027-05-13 14:00 PT, 2027-05-14 15:00 PT, 2027-05-14 16:00 PT
- Pre-read we will send 24 hours prior (run-of-show + top-level graphs + raw sample CSV)

I attached our readout template (redwood-readout-template.pdf) — Monica, can you confirm the runbook items you want to surface and whether we need console access for an hour?

If those slots don't work for any of your folks, tell us the absolute hard blocker time and we'll re-slot.

Thanks,
Vivek

Thanks — 2027-05-14 15:00 PT is good for our engs. Adding Sam (procurement) and Lia (security) to this thread — Sam, Lia: main asks are cost/unit estimates for the burst profile, retention of logs for audit, and evidence of isolation for dedicated pools.

A couple of asks before the readout:
- Could you include a short appendix in the pre-read comparing KV cache on vs off with the measurement runs?
- We'd like to see one example tail trace (p99.9) with timestamps and the corresponding hardware annotation if available.

If you can send the pre-read by EOD 2027-05-13 that gives our engineering/security folks time to prepare.

—Amaya

- Slide 5: KV cache on vs off comparison (p50/p95/p99 across three runs)
